person_made_it: Built for Foster from his own words in today's chat: tap to any beat, five zones that free different parts, the freed part wriggles, a whole-frame gradual shoggoth squeeze.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The expedition's field note speaks (FANGSPEARE Expedition, Excavation 02); Darby signs the text message, not the game.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Polar night under the ice: black, teal ice and the shoggoth's green eyes, lit by the Old One's red eyes.
did_the_click_pay_me: Every tap pays instantly with a crack sound, flying ice shards and spreading fractures; every fifth of the ice frees a wriggling part; the last break drops the track.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone portrait first, tap anywhere, no wrong taps, a win in about 15 s; a WebKit phone-viewport QA run is required before sending.
taught_me_something: It shows Foster his redesign working; it teaches the player nothing new beyond the song and the canon.
told_me_the_truth: The release date stays off it until Foster confirms 12/1 or 12/2; nothing claims a physical-phone test it did not get.
weakest: The HUD uses Unity's default font instead of Oswald and Special Elite; swap it next.
